title: Harden lease-derived sandbox profile compilation
purpose: Ensure AgentCore execution cannot weaken sandbox constraints chosen from capability leases.
scope: Compile sandbox profiles exclusively from CapabilityLease and policy metadata.
Define profile classes for read-only diagnostics, write-with-diff preparation, execute-with-confirmation, and never.
Keep read-only persistent write denial and resource limits from the MVP.
Add profile audit summaries with namespace, cgroup, seccomp/no_new_privs, Landlock placeholder, and network allowlist fields.
Fail closed when the required sandbox class is unsupported.
acceptance_criteria: Read-only leases compile to profiles with no persistent write access.
Planner output cannot add writable host paths or broaden network access.
Unsupported risk classes fail closed until explicitly implemented.
Sandbox profile metadata appears in the EffectEnvelope.
Resource abuse fixtures still hit configured limits.
verification: Attempt planner-provided writable path injection and confirm it is ignored or denied.
Inspect audit output for profile metadata.
risk_notes: Sandbox profiles must be compiled from authority, not from agent suggestions.
implementation_steps: Compile namespace, cgroup, seccomp/no_new_privs, filesystem, Landlock placeholder, and network constraints exclusively from CapabilityLease and policy metadata.
Ignore or audit planner-provided sandbox weakening hints.
Define profile classes for read-only diagnostics, write-with-diff preparation, execute-with-confirmation, privileged, and never.
Fail closed when required sandbox profile class is unsupported.
Attach stable sandbox profile summaries to EffectEnvelope and audit projection.
Preserve MVP read-only persistent write denial and resource limits.
failure_modes: Planner adds writable host path or network egress through sandbox hints.
Read-only lease receives persistent write permission.
Unsupported risk class defaults to permissive behavior.
Sandbox profile metadata is absent from EffectEnvelope or audit projection.
Resource abuse fixtures bypass configured limits.

verification_matrix.expected: read-only denial, resource limits, and profile compilation tests pass
lease authority, ignored planner hints, unsupported risk, and profile summary tests pass
sandbox hardening does not regress AgentCore or safety suites

blocked_until: Sandbox profile authority comes from leases.
